    Get data from GXPA

    get_data_from_gxpa.Rd

    Get data from GXPA for a given series id and genes

    Usage

    get_data_from_gxpa(series_id, genes, GXPA_TOKEN = Sys.getenv("GXPA_TOKEN"))

    Arguments

    series_id

    dataset series id

    genes

    select genes

    GXPA_TOKEN

    GXPA API token. Default is to use the environment variable GXPA_TOKEN

    Value

    a data.frame of expression values for selected genes and sample annotation information.

    Details

    Go to GXPA Settings to get your token. Some datasets require you to login, so be sure to do that before you copy your token.

    Token can be set by:

    • For the current session:

      • Sys.setenv(GXPA_TOKEN = "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX")

    • For all sessions:

      • usethis::edit_r_environ(),

      • adding: GXPA_TOKEN = "XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"

    Examples

    dat <- get_data_from_gxpa(series_id = 41, genes = c("CD33", "CD34"))
#> These genes not present:
#> CD33
#> CD34
head(dat)
